title: LA passage: Vexilla Regis
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a la passage.

Vexilla Regis

Language: la

anchor.prefix: is the highest glory of the hymnal. It is an intricate and soothing hymn. I like it; but there is no hymn that can be put beside that mournful and majestic processional song, the
anchor.suffix:
of Venantius Fortunatus.

 Lynch began to sing softly and solemnly in a deep bass voice:

 Inpleta sunt quæ concinit
David fideli carmine
Dicendo nationibus
Regnavit a ligno Deus.
